title: Democratic or Authoritarian? Probing a New Dimension of Political Biases in Large Language Models

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating implicit authoritarian tendencies using the psychometric F-scale, measuring favorability toward world leaders across democratic and authoritarian regimes using the survey-adapted FavScore metric, and analyzing the political alignment of figures generated in a national role-model naming task.

Comparing model responses on political value probes, leader favorability questions, and role-model tasks across English and Mandarin prompts to measure how the language of interaction shifts ideological alignment and outputs.
